full_name: Rethink Priorities (AI governance & strategy, digital consciousness)
mission: Rethink Priorities is a research organisation that helps funders and policymakers prioritise across animal welfare, global health, global catastrophic risks and more. On AI, it incubated the Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) out of its AI Governance & Strategy team, runs public-opinion surveys on AI risk, and builds the Digital Consciousness Model for judging whether AI systems might be conscious. It also gives operational support to young AI-safety organisations.

key_work.title: Initial results of the Digital Consciousness Model
key_work.plain_summary: A scientific framework that scores AI systems against many theories of consciousness to estimate how likely they are to be conscious.

key_work.title: Introducing the Institute for AI Policy and Strategy
key_work.plain_summary: RP's AI Governance & Strategy team relaunched as IAPS, a think tank focused on reducing risks from frontier AI through research and talent pipelines.

key_work.title: US public opinion of AI policy and risk
key_work.plain_summary: A nationally representative US poll on attitudes to AI risk and policy, replicating and extending other surveys.

key_work.title: Prospects for AI safety agreements between countries
key_work.plain_summary: Investigates whether countries could reach international agreements to coordinate on AI safety, and what they might look like.

key_work.title: AI Safety Bounties
key_work.plain_summary: Explores paying members of the public or approved security researchers to find safety problems in AI systems, like bug bounties.

key_work.title: Risk Alignment in Agentic AI Systems
key_work.plain_summary: Asks how much risk an AI agent should take on behalf of users, developers and society, and how to align its risk attitudes.

status_note: its AI Governance & Strategy team became the Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) in 2023, incubated by RP and spinning off as a fully separate entity in 2026; RP's own AI work now centres on AI consciousness/welfare research, AI-related surveys and incubating AI-safety projects

warnings.text: RP polling found a majority of the US public agreed with the statement that mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority.
We may soon build AI systems whose moral status is genuinely uncertain.
Agentic AI systems may take on risks their users and society would not accept.

recommendations.text: Study AI consciousness systematically across many theories rather than relying on one view.
Explore AI safety bounties and international safety agreements as governance tools.
Incubate and operationally support new AI-safety organisations.
